newsitem.title: JAPAN: Govt finance units have non-performing loans - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Govt finance units have non-performing loans - MOF.

text.p: Japan's government-affiliated financial institutions had a total of 869.2 billion yen in loans whose interest payments were in arrears by six months or longer as of March 31 last year, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told parliament's Upper House on Wednesday.
Mitsuzuka said loans that were in arrears accounted for 0.76 percent of the outstanding loans of quasi-governmental financial institutions.
Eleven public financial institutions, such as the Export-Import Bank and the Housing Loan Corp, use public money collected in the form of pension and postal savings.
"Each financial body is trying to prevent loans in arrears from increasing by conducting proper screening before making decisions on lending," Mitsuzuka said.
